<<Notes on Cleaning A Telescope Mirror>>  
Regular cleaning of telescope mirrors is essential for optimal performance. Use a soft cloth and distilled water to wipe the surface, avoiding abrasive materials. Dry the mirror with a clean, dry cloth to prevent water spots. Store the telescope in a clean, dry place when not in use. Clean mirrors frequently to maintain clarity and ensure accurate observations. Always follow safety guidelines and consult a telescope manual for specific care instructions.
